description: Returns per-tool call duration metrics for a conversation with an explicit latency boundary. Includes individual call records and aggregates, or exact Agent-vs-Node paired comparisons with transport/Agent overhead. Use this to identify slow tools and optimize your workflow.

conversationId.description: Conversation ID to fetch tool metrics for. Defaults to the current conversation if omitted.

measurementScope.description: Latency boundary. agent_round_trip includes Agent, network, Node routing, and response handling; node_server measures the Node request path; comparison pairs both clocks by exact toolCallId.

toolName.description: Filter results to a specific tool name.

name: get_tool_call_metrics
title: Tool Call Metrics
